lines:
Responsibilities: Writes bounded machine-local process, storage, IPC, migration, and health diagnostics delivered through the trusted-core logging/supervision boundary. It supports troubleshooting without replacing semantic evidence.
Owned records/files: size- and age-rotated structured JSONL/text files, rotation manifest, optional compressed closed generations, and DiagnosticRecordId composed from writer/process generation plus local sequence. Supervisor-proxied worker/host output is sanitized before this sink; those processes never read or write files here directly.
Keys and ordering: sequence is monotonic only within writer/process generation; wall time and monotonic offset aid display but do not establish cross-process or Chat event order. Correlation uses opaque Chat/Event/Attempt/Invocation IDs.
Ports: exposes nonblocking RedactedDiagnosticSinkPort through the existing Trusted Core to Local Store boundary, paginated DiagnosticReadPort to the core Desktop API/projections/repair correlations, and rotation/integrity maintenance to the storage coordinator.
Durability/degraded behavior: append/rotation uses atomic manifest replacement and crash-tolerant closed segments. Logging failure, disk-full, corrupt segment, or compression failure increments an in-memory/drop counter and emits a minimal platform diagnostic; it never blocks canonical commits or effects. Corrupt generations are isolated and skipped explicitly.
Retention/performance: defaults to ten 20 MiB generations plus seven days, configurable within a hard global quota; closed generations compress asynchronously. The bounded queue drops lowest-severity repetitive records first and emits one aggregate drop record. Reads are range/cursor based.
Security/non-responsibilities: credential values, authorization headers, prompt bodies, secret leases, environment secrets, unredacted protocol frames, and hidden reasoning are forbidden; allowlisted structured fields and redaction are applied before persistence. Logs are not canonical history, an audit guarantee, full stream capture, effect replay input, or a direct worker/host channel.

data.name: Rotating Redacted Diagnostic Log Store
data.technology: Rust asynchronous rotating structured file logger
